title: Portal of Whispers
description: A surreal scene set in a decaying green room overgrown with vines and littered with film reels, dice, and skulls. A woman in ornate orange and purple robes reaches toward a large gilded mirror that acts as a portal revealing a mountainous landscape at sunset, where a ghostly white figure in a purple dress stands; a large purple octopus-like creature with glowing eyes emerges from the left while translucent spirits, butterflies, and a panda float throughout the chaotic space.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene inside a decaying room with green vine-covered walls and scattered film reels, skulls and dice. A woman in flowing orange pants and ornate purple robes reaches toward a large ornate gilded mirror that serves as a portal to a mountain landscape at sunset. Inside the portal stands a translucent woman in a white and orange dress. A large purple octopus creature with glowing yellow eyes emerges from the left side. Translucent spirits, butterflies, a small panda, and a black bird float in the air. Ethereal glowing particles and magical atmosphere fill the room.
